description.value:
Frequency once per patient per week

Trigger A willing patient of yours rolls a Runaway Mutation result on the Bloom Table.

Roll a second result on the Minor Mutation table alongside the one that triggered. The patient takes whichever of the two you choose, and the other is discarded entirely — it never happened, and doesn't count against anything. This doesn't let you avoid a Runaway Mutation happening at all, only steer which one lands.
